messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion check failed soft policy: chart=payments-v3.2 detected values mismatch: forwarding.sidecar.tag expected=redwood/pay-sidecar:v3.1.0 actual=redwood/pay-sidecar:v3.2.0 in 2/10 canary pods. severity=warn. cmd: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=payments -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}'`
anna_eng: I saw the 504s earlier. Is that sidecar bump from overlay or from chart?
matt: looked at promoted manifest: chart version=3.2.0 is fine. overlay payment-overlay.yaml set `forwarding.sidecar.tag: v3.2.0`. must have been merged last night.
lina: options: abort promotion, apply pin, or proceed and isolate canary. Given change window open for 2h, I'd prefer pin + keep canary running.
matt: plan: helm upgrade payments-release charts/payments --namespace prod --version 3.2.0 --reuse-values --set forwarding.sidecar.tag=v3.1.0 --set imagePromotion.note=pin-rollout-2026-04-05. Keep canary labelled `tier=canary`.
anna_eng: commands:
```bash
helm upgrade payments-release charts/payments --namespace prod --version 3.2.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set forwarding.sidecar.tag=v3.1.0 \
  --set imagePromotion.note=pin-rollout-2026-04-05
kubectl -n prod label deployment payments-svc tier=canary --overwrite
```
release-manager: add brief release-note blurb and notify infra-oncall. document the pin in audit.
lina: rollback plan: `helm rollback payments-release 7` and remove pin if regressions. If canary misbehaves, scale canary replicas to zero: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment payments-svc --replicas=0 -l tier=canary`
matt: doing helm dry-run and will paste diff. Found extra canary-only env `FORWARDING_DEBUG=true` in overlay. Putting that in ticket RD-5933.
matt: helm template diff:
```diff
--- a/templates/deployment.yaml
+++ b/templates/deployment.yaml
@@
-        image: redwood/pay-sidecar:v3.2.0
+        image: redwood/pay-sidecar:v3.1.0  # pinned for rollout
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled watch: payments-startup-watch (30m). thresholds: pod_ready_latency>20s, error_rate>0.02, restart_count>2.
nanna_eng: created RD-5933, assigned to ops + eng-qa. release-notes: impact=low, mitigation=pin sidecar, follow-up=overlay sync and patch release.
matt: promoted at 3968900045. Helm upgrade reported success, rollout completed. Canary (2 pods) still running v3.2.0 for analysis.
lina: watching metrics. small transient increase in pulls but stable. will keep 30m watch.
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned rollout. follow-up: schedule point release to unify sidecar tags across overlays. close thread after watch if stable. :white_check_mark:
